name: tsql-fabric-debugger-vscode
description: Debug T-SQL (Transact-SQL) stored procedures on the Microsoft Fabric Warehouse: breakpoints, step over/into/out, watch variables and a result-set grid — with ROLLBACK. Pull, edit and deploy procedures and notebooks.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Connect to a warehouse to browse and debug its stored procedures.
[Connect to Warehouse](command:tsqlFabric.connect)
[Check setup](command:tsqlFabric.checkSetup)

Debug T-SQL stored procedures on Microsoft Fabric — right here.

First, connect to a warehouse (you pick it from a list; the endpoint is filled in for you).
[Connect to Warehouse](command:tsqlFabric.connect)
[Check setup](command:tsqlFabric.checkSetup)

Sign-in uses the Azure CLI (az login). Nothing is written to the warehouse — every debug run ends in ROLLBACK.

No .sql or .ipynb files in this folder yet.
[Open a folder](command:vscode.openFolder)

tsqlFabric.server.markdownDescription: Default Fabric Warehouse SQL endpoint (e.g. `xxxx.datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com`). Used when a launch configuration omits `server`.

tsqlFabric.database.markdownDescription: Default warehouse name. Used when a launch configuration omits `database`.

tsqlFabric.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter that has `tsql-fabric-debugger` installed. Empty = use the interpreter selected by the Python extension, else `python3` on PATH.

tsqlFabric.adapterCommand.markdownDescription: Override the debug adapter command. Empty = run `<python> -m tsql_fabric_debugger.dap`. Set to `tsql-fabric-dap` to use the installed console script directly.

tsqlFabric.lockTimeout.markdownDescription: Seconds a debug step waits on a lock before failing (SET LOCK_TIMEOUT). Bounds how long a paused debug can block other sessions on a shared/production warehouse. `0` disables (wait forever — not recommended).

tsqlFabric.stepTimeout.markdownDescription: Seconds a single step may run before it is cancelled. `0` = no limit. Set a limit on production to bound heavy statements.

tsqlFabric.productionWarehouses.markdownDescription: Warehouse names or endpoint substrings you consider **production**. Debugging one of these asks for confirmation first (a debug session holds locks while paused) and marks the status bar. Example: `["wh_prod", "prod.datawarehouse"]`.

enumDescriptions: A dim 'breakpoint' label at the end of each statement line
A thin bar on the left edge of each statement line
tsqlFabric.breakpointLineHint.markdownDescription: How to mark the lines a breakpoint can actually pause on (statement starts). The debugger only stops at the start of each statement — a breakpoint on `BEGIN`/`END`, a blank/comment line or a continuation line never fires. Neither style sits on the gutter click target, so setting breakpoints still works. Computed offline; no connection needed.

tsqlFabric.localFolder.markdownDescription: Project subfolder where **Open Source** saves a procedure's `.sql` and **Export for Fabric deploy** writes the generated `.sql` + `.ipynb`.

enumDescriptions: procedures/<schema>/<name> and deploy/<schema>/<name> (by type, then schema)
<schema>/<name> (a folder per schema, no type split)
procedures/<schema>.<name> and deploy/<schema>.<name> (by type, flat name)
tsqlFabric.fileLayout.markdownDescription: How pulled sources and generated artifacts are laid out inside the base folder. `procedures/` holds what you pull from Fabric; `deploy/` holds what you generate to publish.

tsqlFabric.gitRemote.markdownDescription: Git remote name to push to from **Commit & Push Fabric folder**. Empty = the current branch's upstream (or `origin` on the first push). Uses your existing Git credentials via the built-in Git extension.

tsqlFabric.gitCommitMessage.markdownDescription: Default commit message suggested by **Commit & Push Fabric folder** (you can edit it each time).

program.description: Path to the .sql file with the CREATE PROCEDURE.

procName.description: Instead of a file: a DEPLOYED procedure name (schema.proc) whose source is fetched from the warehouse.

server.description: Warehouse SQL endpoint. Falls back to the tsqlFabric.server setting.

database.description: Warehouse name. Falls back to the tsqlFabric.database setting.

maxLoopIterations.description: Guard: pause a WHILE that exceeds this many iterations.

historyBatches.description: Keep the batch text for the last N steps only (bounds memory on long loops). null = keep all.

stepTimeout.description: Fail a step that runs longer than this many seconds.

lockTimeout.description: Fail a lock-blocked step after this many seconds instead of hanging.
